Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI LODR ) including circulars issued thereunder and other applicable provisions, if any, as amended from time to time, and in continuation to our intimation dated October 27, 2026, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e. November 03, 2026 commenced at 16:00 Hrs (IST) and concluded at 18:15 Hrs (IST) has, inter-alia, considered and approved the following along with other matters:a) On the recommendation of the Audit Committee, the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, together with Limited Review Report of the Statutory Auditors, that were placed before the Board of Directors and was taken on record.b) On the recommendation of the Audit Committee, Standalone and Consolidated Statement of Assets and Liabilities as on September 30, 2026.c) On the recommendation of the Audit Committee, Standalone and Consolidated Statement of Cash Flow for the half year ended September 30, 2026.d) Approved proposed capacity expansion by addition of new channels at various locations.e) Brand Launch: On 3 November,2026, the SKF Vertevo brand is officially launched across theorganization and to our customers and stakeholders worldwide. The brand is the face of ourcompany, it shows our personality what we stand for, what we are passionate about and what our customers can expect from us.The SKF Vertevo brand is inspired by the world of racing, where the company has contributed to automotive innovation for decades. The identity is designed to keep a connection to the long SKF heritage and expertise, while signalling its ambition to help accelerate the future of mobility.Please note that only the brand is being launched, while the company name continues to remain the same. Any further developments will be communicated to stakeholders as and when applicable.Note: The company had already submitted the financial results for the period ended 30-Sep-2026 on 03rd November 2026. The company is re-submitting the same intimation in machine-readable format as instructed by NSE.
